cloudflare.kv.reads.note: Keys read (a bulk read counts every key). The first 10 million a month are free units, included in Workers Paid for the whole account ("10 million/month, + $0.50/million", https://developers.cloudflare.com/kv/platform/pricing/). Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

cloudflare.kv.storage.note: The first 1 GB is free units, included in Workers Paid for the whole account ("1 GB, + $0.50/ GB-month", https://developers.cloudflare.com/kv/platform/pricing/). Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

cloudflare.kv.writes.note: Keys written, keys deleted and list requests are each $5.00 per million. The plan includes 1 million of each a month for the whole account (https://developers.cloudflare.com/kv/platform/pricing/); only the 1 million writes are given as free units, so deletes and lists counted as writes get no allowance of their own. Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it
